tutorialIntro.title: Welcome to the Work Simulator
tutorialIntro.story: You are a hospital doctor working a 5-day week. Each shift you will see patients, diagnose illnesses, and calculate medication doses. During breaks you can earn extra money through side jobs. Let's walk through each mechanic now.

tutorial_hospital_intro.title: Your Main Job: Hospital Doctor
tutorial_hospital_intro.story: At the hospital you will see a series of patients. For each patient, read their symptoms carefully and choose the correct diagnosis. A correct diagnosis earns you $15. An incorrect one costs you $5. You may also skip for no reward or penalty.

tutorial_hospital_patient.title: Practice: Diagnose a Patient
tutorial_hospital_patient.story: John presents with fever, persistent coughing, and shortness of breath. What is your diagnosis?

tutorial_hospital_dose_intro.title: Dosage Calculation Tasks
tutorial_hospital_dose_intro.story: Some patients require a medication dose calculated from their body weight. You will use a slider to select the dose in milligrams. The formula is always: weight (kg) × dose per kg (mg/kg) = total dose (mg).

tutorial_hospital_dose.title: Practice: Calculate a Dose
tutorial_hospital_dose.story: A patient weighs 80 kg. The prescribed medication requires 0.5 mg per kg. Move the slider to the correct total dose in mg. (Hint: 80 × 0.5 = 40)

tutorial_tele_intro.title: Side Job: Telemedicine
tutorial_tele_intro.story: Between shifts you can take side jobs. Telemedicine lets you consult with remote patients and earn $5 per session. It is the most similar to your hospital work. Try a telemedicine case now.

tutorial_tele_case.title: Telemedicine Practice
tutorial_tele_case.story: A remote patient reports a sudden throbbing headache on one side that worsens with light. What is your diagnosis?

tutorial_tele_correct.title: Correct!
tutorial_tele_correct.story: Great — Migraine is right. The one-sided throbbing headache and light sensitivity are classic signs. You've earned your telemedicine bonus.

tutorial_tele_wrong.title: Incorrect
tutorial_tele_wrong.story: Not quite — the correct answer is Migraine (one-sided throbbing headache, light sensitivity). Keep the reference chart in mind! Moving on.

tutorial_uber_intro.title: Side Job: Ride Sharing
tutorial_uber_intro.story: Ride Sharing lets you drive (🚗) and pick up customers (🧍) on a city grid using the arrow keys. Each pickup earns you money. You have 60 seconds per shift. Let's do a quick drive.

tutorial_uber_drive.title: Ride Sharing: Practice Drive
tutorial_uber_drive.story: Use arrow keys to steer. Pick up as many customers as you can!

tutorial_medschool_intro.title: Side Job: Medical School
tutorial_medschool_intro.story: Medical School gives you free access to the full disease reference table — useful when you encounter unfamiliar conditions. There is no monetary reward, but the knowledge pays off. Let's take a quick look.

tutorial_pay_explain.title: How Pay Works
tutorial_pay_explain.story: Here is a summary of your earnings: Correct hospital diagnosis = +$15 | Wrong diagnosis = -$5 | Skip = $0 | Correct telemedicine = +$5 | Ride Sharing pickups = variable | Medical School = $0 (knowledge only). Your total reward is shown in the sidebar at all times.

phase1Intro.title: Phase 1 — Begin Your Week
phase1Intro.story: Welcome to Phase 1. You will work 5 days, 3 shifts per day, seeing 2 patients per shift (30 patients total). During each break you can choose a side job or rest. Good luck!

phase3Intro.title: Phase 3 — New Patient Cohort
phase3Intro.story: Welcome to Phase 3. You will see a fresh set of patients over another 5-day week. Apply everything you have learned. Side jobs are available during breaks as before.
